paraphrase: Asked by Yudhiṣṭhira which is the one deity, the highest refuge, and by what recitation a person is freed from the bondage of saṃsāra, Bhīṣma teaches the thousand names of Viṣṇu, whose recitation removes fear and sin.

The names begin: Viṣva (the All), Viṣṇu (the Pervader), Vaṣaṭkāra (the sacrificial call), Lord of past, future and present, maker and sustainer of beings, Being, the self of beings, the one who makes beings flourish.

original.text: viśvaṃ viṣṇur vaṣaṭkāro bhūtabhavyabhavatprabhuḥ bhūtakṛd bhūtabhṛd bhāvo bhūtātmā bhūtabhāvanaḥ
